channel.title: GLAMSHUB: GLAM institutions damaged or destroyed
channel.description: Reports of damage to galleries, libraries, archives and museums worldwide.

item.title: Artworks reported removed from Kherson Regional Art Museum during occupation
item.description: Ukrainian officials reported that a large part of the collection was taken away while the city was occupied. (Kherson · Ukraine · looted)

item.title: Skovoroda literary museum in Kharkiv region destroyed by a missile strike
item.description: A strike during the Russian invasion wrecked the museum building dedicated to the philosopher and poet. (Kharkiv region · Ukraine · destroyed)

item.title: Fire engulfs the National Museum of Brazil in Rio de Janeiro
item.description: A fire swept through the historic palace that housed the museum, destroying most of its collections. (Rio de Janeiro · Brazil · destroyed)

item.title: Mosul Central Library books burned by armed extremists
item.description: Fighters who controlled the city burned large parts of the library's collection. (Mosul · Iraq · destroyed)

item.title: Manuscript institute in Timbuktu set on fire as armed groups withdrew
item.description: Retreating fighters burned part of a manuscript centre, though much of the collection had been smuggled out earlier. (Timbuktu · Mali · damaged)

item.title: Institut d'Égypte in Cairo burned during street clashes
item.description: A fire during clashes near Tahrir Square destroyed much of the scholarly society's library and rare holdings. (Cairo · Egypt · destroyed)

item.title: Historical Archive of the City of Cologne collapses during subway construction
item.description: The archive building fell into a construction pit, burying one of Europe's largest municipal archives; recovery and restoration took years. (Cologne · Germany · damaged)

item.title: Iraq's National Library and Archive burned and looted in 2003
item.description: The building was set on fire and looted in the chaos after the invasion, with heavy losses to book and archive holdings. (Baghdad · Iraq · damaged)

item.title: Iraq Museum in Baghdad looted after the fall of the city
item.description: Thousands of objects were taken in the days after the city fell; a large share has since been recovered. (Baghdad · Iraq · looted)

item.title: National and University Library of Bosnia and Herzegovina burned in the siege of Sarajevo
item.description: Shelling set the City Hall building on fire, and most of the library's collections were lost in the blaze. (Sarajevo · Bosnia and Herzegovina · destroyed)

item.title: Jaffna Public Library burned during communal violence
item.description: A mob set the library on fire, destroying tens of thousands of volumes including rare manuscripts. (Jaffna · Sri Lanka · destroyed)

item.title: Arno flood submerges Florence's national library and other collections
item.description: Floodwater and mud damaged an enormous number of books, manuscripts and artworks, prompting a landmark international conservation effort. (Florence · Italy · damaged)
